# Review input baseline

`baseline.json` was generated by executing `createReviewInput` and `judge` at commit `af50608` in the detached checkout `/tmp/nomorevibe-speed-baseline-20260921`, with the fixed UTC clock and public synthetic cases stored in the artifact. The ignored generator for this session is that checkout's `scripts/generate-speed-fixtures.mts`.

`tests/review-pipeline-equivalence.test.ts` reconstructs Dates and compares the entire serialized input, identity hashes, source, policy and rule output. These are baseline-equivalence fixtures, not human accuracy labels. Publication approval, independent voters, source changes, aliases and failure cases use the existing real-DB publication/change/second-review integration suites plus new handoff/draining/text-race suites. No external model is needed.
